decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera sits at the core of the firm's star-tracker and camera heritage, and long space qualification and sales cycles favor keeping it.
The modular multi-model camera line serves the growing small-satellite market and matches the firm's push toward flexible, compact sensors.
The miniaturized LiDAR supports the firm's docking and rendezvous strategy and is likely being matured further, though its low web presence points to some uncertainty.
This newly launched radiation-hard camera line has its own page and fits the firm's core imaging business for demanding missions.
The asteroid navigation camera is probably tied to a specific deep-space mission, so the firm will keep supporting it while that mission runs, despite its niche character.
